title: Global Config: your account settings
summary: Change your password from Global Config; admins find Company, Users and Backup here too.

steps.text: Open {settings} from the sidebar footer. Every signed-in role can use this page's Password tab to set a new one, entering it twice as {confirm}; admins also see Company, Users and Backup tabs here, and the owner also sees {menu}, where they choose what the sidebar offers.

On {title}, choose which entries and groups the side menu shows and in what order, for everyone in the company. Hiding an entry does not block its page. {reset} shows every entry again in its default order.

You can also ask the assistant to change the company's details or what the side menu offers. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm. Changing your own password stays with you on this page.
